description: OS MasterMap Water Network Layer is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. OS MasterMap Water Network Layer will become "end of life" on 31st March 2026. OS MasterMap Water Network Layer offers one of the world’s most detailed, heighted water networks – showing the flow and precise course of every river, stream, lake and canal in Great Britain. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. Its tags are canal, catchment area, flow, river, tidal water. The portal shows 2025-04-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
